page.offBody: Switch them on in the project settings to link scenes with choices: whatever was there comes back.
page.emptyTitle: The flow shows how the scenes connect: create a scene and mark it as the start.
page.emptyBody: A scene without choices continues to the next one; choices open the branches.
page.lead: How the scenes connect: the choices, the conditions that open them, the endings.

inspector.label: The scene in the flow
inspector.startOff: Make it the scene where everything starts.
inspector.endingHelp: The story can end here: it does not continue on its own.

checks.clean: No problems: every scene can be reached and every path reaches an ending.

messages.noStart: There is no start scene: choose where the story begins.
messages.brokenTarget: The choice “{choice}” in “{scene}” leads to a scene in the trash.
messages.trashedVariable: The choice “{choice}” in “{scene}” uses a variable in the trash.
messages.badRule: In the choice “{choice}” in “{scene}”, a condition or an effect does not fit its variable's type.

messages.deadEnd: “{scene}” is a dead end: not an ending, and it leads nowhere.
messages.noEnding: No scene is an ending: mark where the story can end.
messages.emptyText: A choice in “{scene}” has no text: among several choices, the {audience} needs to know what they pick.
messages.unusedVariable: The variable {variable} is not used by any condition or effect.
messages.unchangedVariable: {variable} is read by {n} condition but no effect changes it: it is always {value}. | {variable} is read by {n} conditions but no effect changes it: it is always {value}.

variables.offBody: Switch them on in the project settings to give choices conditions and effects.
variables.lead: The state the game remembers: choice conditions read it, effects change it.
variables.emptyTitle: Variables remember what the {audience} did: a key found, an ally's trust, a door left open.
variables.emptyBody: Give it a short name, like {a} or {b}: choices will use it in their conditions and effects.
variables.name: Name
variables.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Renaming it leaves the choices that use it intact.
variables.descriptionHelp: What it is for and when it changes: it goes into the documents for the team.
variables.errorRule: Only lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
variables.errorRuleSuggest: Only lowercase letters, digits and underscores: for example {name}.
variables.errorTaken: There is already a variable called {name}.
variables.typeChanged: Used in {n} choice: check its condition and effects, the flow checks point out what no longer fits. | Used in {n} choices: check their conditions and effects, the flow checks point out what no longer fits.
variables.trashedUsed: Used in {n} choice: the choice stays, and the checks will point it out. | Used in {n} choices: the choices stay, and the checks will point them out.
